subject: general
question: What is the 2025 theme for World Population Day?

options.text: Population Control for a Sustainable Earth
Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Population Day: 11 July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Population Day** is observed **annually on July 11**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2025**, the **global population crosses 8.1 billion**, and **India becomes the most populous country**.

 
 
• 
 
The day was established in **1989** by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**.

 
 
• 
 
It was inspired by **Five Billion Day** (**July 11, 1987**) — when the **world population reached 5 billion**.

 
 
• 
 
**Theme for 2025**:
 **“Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world.”**
